fit_reason: Despite being tagged as a private seller, this is dealer stock: showroom photos, multiple units in different colors, in-house financing, trade-ins and trailer options offered. It is a new pontoon, not a private owner's sale.
findings: New showroom pontoon with clean, unworn white and gray vinyl seating throughout
Clean gray deck carpet with no visible stains or debris
Black rail panels and helm console look new and glossy
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Bennington 22SSR. The seating and deck look showroom clean in the photos. If you ever have trade-in boats that need a pre-sale detail or gelcoat polish before they go back out, we come to you. Would you like a quote for those?
